title: Vinci, which makes software used to simulate elements of chip and other hardware design, raised $250M at a $1.5B valuation (Max A. Cherney/Reuters)
summary: Max A. Cherney / Reuters: Vinci, which makes software used to simulate elements of chip and other hardware design, raised $250M at a $1.5B valuation — Software startup Vinci said on Tuesday it raised $250 million at a $1.5 billion valuation and is seeking to expand its suite of software used to simulate elements of chip and other hardware design.
